cutoff: root must declare after all target and receipt writers finish
inventory: all regular files, including later attempts; reject or explicitly handle symlinks
requiredRetention: all plans, commands, observations, provenance and resource receipts
all consumed source/tool versions and independent control fixtures
all failed, refused, corrected, stopped and uninstalled attempt records
all prime/check/counted and ten clean compiler-memo request reports
one retained content object per distinct executed API/module digest, unless explicitly regeneration-only
deduplication: exact bytes by final verified digest; logical paths and statuses remain in complete inventory

priorCapsule.requirement: verify exact member recovery at closure before assigning external retained-byte status

producerLimit: archives every supplied-root member; selection requires reviewed materialization first
publication: outside closed raw root; ordered parts at most 40 MiB, reopened concatenation verified
claims: No final member hashes/counts, archive durability, executable retention, installation or performance promotion established by this proposal. Digest plus source recipe means regeneration-only unless exact retained bytes are recoverable.
